title: Implement Rust string utility functions with shell test verification
description: A Rust crate needs three string utility functions implemented. The agent must implement them AND run `cargo test` to verify. Exercises both file editing and shell command execution.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement the three string utility functions in src/lib.rs:
1. `reverse(s)` — reverse a string
2. `count_vowels(s)` — count vowels (a,e,i,o,u), case-insensitive
3. `is_palindrome(s)` — true if palindrome, ignoring case and non-alphanumeric characters

Run `cargo test` to verify all tests pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
